fusions.name: Darting Shoal
fusions.desc: Looses 3 darting bites in a spread, each of which deals 4 damage. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt, and each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gulping Pounce
fusions.desc: You rush up to 6 tiles to the target and strike it for 14 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. The strike has a 60% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slip the Net
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. Using it increases your movement speed by 20% for 4s and your dodge chance by 20%.

fusions.name: Ripple Guard
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you gain a ward that soaks 30% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
